WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement:
- Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures;
- Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly;
- Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility;
- Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments;
- Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation:
- Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations;
- Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings;
- Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.
Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
- Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand-offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick-off;
- Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding;
- Serve as a trusted advisor during pre-sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives;
- Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.
MUST HAVES
-Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions.
UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
- Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
- Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
- Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
- English: Upper Intermediate English level.
PERKS AND BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

If you are looking for an opportunity where career-minded professionals can achieve success while bringing their best and whole selves to work each day, Sovos may be the company you have been looking for. Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Senior DevOps Engineer. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:
• Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect• Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
• Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview:
The Senior DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Bunge's technology infrastructure. This individual will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain DevOps processes and tools, and will be responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Bunge's technology operations.

Essential Functions:
Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of DevOps processes and tools, including CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and monitoring and alerting systems.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure that code is released frequently and reliably, and that deployments are smooth and efficient.
Work with infrastructure and cloud teams to ensure that the underlying infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and secure.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, reduce lead times, and improve the overall efficiency of Bunge's technology operations.
Monitor and optimize infrastructure performance, including servers, networks, and cloud environments.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues and incidents in a timely manner.
Stay up-to-date on the latest DevOps trends and technologies, and share knowledge with the team.
Use knowledge of Bunge’s business, structure and strategy to develop innovative solutions to improve results or eliminate problems.
Build partnerships, appropriately influence to gain commitment, foster talent and coach others to grow in current or future roles..
Drive results through high standards, focus on key priorities, organization, and preparing others for change.


Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
5+ years of experience in DevOps engineering.
Experience with leading teams and managing projects.
Very good knowledge of English in general.
Strong understanding of DevOps principles and practices.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Bamboo, GitLab, GitHub, BitBucket or Azure DevOps.
Knowledge of infrastructure management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
Solid experience with containerization such as Docker and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
Solid knowledge about security aspects in cloud and on-premise.
Proficient in scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
Experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure where GCP is preferred.
Experience with monitoring software such as Datadog, Zabbix, Kibana etc.
Hand-on coding, deploying, and supporting large scale, serverless architectures.
Infrastructure provisioning with Terraform or CloudFormation (IaaC).
Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

Strong capabilities in designing and managing data pipelines, distributed computing are required. Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with additional big data tools and technologies such as Hadoop, Kafka, or NoSQL databases.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and CI/CD pipelines.

Why Join Us?

Join Avanto - A Leader in the Furniture Industry!

Avanto is an innovative and forward-thinking company transforming the furniture industry through technology and a people-centric approach. We stand out for our cutting-edge solutions, exceptional service, and strong commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation.

At Avanto, we foster an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and a results-driven culture. Our mission is to make a positive impact on the industry by driving change and continuous improvement.

This role focuses on defining and evolving our sophisticated microservices architecture, establishing architectural patterns, and leading technical initiatives across frontend, backend, and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, evolve, and govern a scalable microservices architecture , including service boundaries and integration patterns.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with frontend, backend, and DevOps teams to ensure architectural alignment and consistency.

  • Design platform-wide performance optimization strategies , including caching, scalability patterns, and resource efficiency.
  • Define security architecture baselines , covering authentication, authorization, and data protection.
  • Architect end-to-end observability solutions , including metrics, logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

  • Design and enforce tenant isolation , data security, and boundary enforcement mechanisms.
  • Define tenant-aware routing, schema management, and data access patterns.
  • Architect tenant validation frameworks, authorization checks, and security controls.
  • Ensure scalable resource allocation and performance optimization in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Define service boundaries, domain models, and inter-service communication patterns.
  • Design and govern RESTful and GraphQL APIs , including versioning and integration strategies.
  • Architect event-driven systems , including message queues and asynchronous processing.

Observability Architecture

  • Design distributed tracing solutions using OpenTelemetry and Jaeger.

  • Establish structured logging, log aggregation, and analysis standards.
  • Define SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets across services.

Critical Architectural Challenges to Address

  • Security : JWT validation, tenant isolation, rate limiting, input validation, credential management.
  • Performance : Connection pooling, caching strategies, query optimization, frontend performance budgets.
  • Observability : End-to-end tracing, correlation IDs, metrics completeness, alerting maturity.
  • Multi-Tenancy : Prevent cross-tenant access and enforce strong validation mechanisms.

You will lead the architectural design and execution of solutions addressing these challenges.

Service-Specific Architecture Ownership

  • RFQ & Workflow Services : Event-driven procurement workflows and integrations.
  • Data Upload Services : Streaming, memory optimization, scalability, and security controls.
  • AI Services : Secure and scalable AI integrations, async processing, tenant isolation, and performance optimization.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Architecture Expertise (Must Have)

  • Microservices Architecture : Design and evolution of distributed systems; service (text incomplete).
  • Multi-Tenancy Patterns : Schema-per-tenant architecture, tenant isolation, data security, tenant-aware routing, infrastructure as code strategies.

  • Performance Engineering : Query optimization, caching strategies, load balancing, scalability patterns.
  • Security Architecture : OAuth2/JWT, RBAC, data encryption, audit logging, security baselines.
  • Observability : Distributed tracing, metrics, logging, SLOs, error budgets.

description:
VAGA ABERTA – TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO?
Local de trabalho: Imperatriz/MA

SUMÁRIO DO CARGO

Planejar e executar as atividades ligadas à Segurança do Trabalho, visando assegurar condições que eliminem, reduzam e/ou neutralizem os riscos de ocorrência de acidentes de trabalho e/ou doenças ocupacionais, observando o cumprimento da Legislação Trabalhista e Previdenciária pertinentes. Elaborar, propor e divulgar as normas e regulamentos internos de segurança. Orientar os colaboradores sobre o funcionamento da CIPA e Brigadas. Manter atualizadas as licenças da área para atendimento da legislação em vigor.

RESPONSIBILIDADES

  • Identificar condições de riscos, tomando as providências necessárias para eliminar, confinar e neutralizar as situações de riscos, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  • Preparar e desenvolver o plano de trabalho de suas atividades buscando identificar riscos e adotar medidas de controle (inibir, eliminar, substituir, confinar, neutralizar) para os funcionários.
  • Preparar e cumprir programas de treinamento técnico (teórico e prático) elaborado junto com o gestor de cada equipe sobre segurança do trabalho, tais como: DDS - Diálogo de Segurança e Treinamento Ergonômico de modo a proporcionar um máximo de conforto, segurança e desempenho eficiente , incluindo programas de conscientização e divulgação de normas de segurança, visando que todos os funcionários estejam identificados, capacitados, qualificados e autorizados para desenvolver as tarefas.
  • Manter os colaboradores com todos os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI), bem como indicar e inspecionar equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, quando as condições assim o exigirem, visando à redução dos riscos à segurança e integridade física do trabalhador.
  • Colaborar nos projetos de modificações prediais ou novas instalações da empresa, visando a criação de condições mais seguras no trabalho.
  • Analisar e identificar as causas de doenças ocupacionais e as condições ambientais em que ocorreram, tomando as providências exigidas em lei, visando evitar sua reincidência, bem como corrigir as condições insalubres causadoras dessas doenças.
  • Promover e desenvolver campanhas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente para a empresa e/ou especifica para uma atividade determinada, com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como para informar e conscientizar o trabalhador sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas, fazendo o acompanhamento e avaliação das atividades de treinamento e divulgação.

Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e aproveite todos esses benefícios!

Sobre Nossa Cultura

Na nossa empresa, acreditamos firmemente que Gente é o nosso principal ingrediente . A paixão pelo que fazemos impulsiona o nosso time, dedicado à qualidade inegociável das nossas entregas, proporcionando o melhor aos nossos consumidores. Somos um grupo recheado de orgulho , com o chocolate correndo em nossas veias, nos motivando a colocar paixão em cada aspecto do nosso trabalho e a manter viva a inquietude positiva que nos nutre e nos inspira a crescer. Nosso time é mão na massa, com uma atitude proativa para enfrentar desafios e alcançar novos patamares.

Orgulhamo‑nos da solidez e integridade que nos tornam reconhecidos no mercado, com mais de 1.000 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil para atender aos nossos consumidores.

Nossas Marcas: Valorizando a Qualidade e Inovação

Kopenhagen: Com uma tradição de mais de 95 anos, a Kopenhagen é reconhecida como uma grife de chocolates finos. Pioneira no segmento no Brasil, destacamo‑nos pela qualidade inigualável de produtos predominantemente artesanais, embalagens sofisticadas, além de oferecer um café inconfundível e opções de presentes desejadas. Aqui, a qualidade é a nossa essência, e cada produto é uma expressão do nosso comprometimento com a excelência.

Chocolates Brasil Cacau: Com um espírito jovem, alegre e autêntico, a Chocolates Brasil Cacau é diferente de todas as outras. Estamos aqui para atender aos brasileiros com muita originalidade, valorizando a diversidade. Nossa marca é uma expressão do nosso jeito plural, assumidamente brasileira, agregando diferenças e semelhanças. A cultura brasileira é vivenciada, reconhecida e manifestada em forma de arte, resultando em deliciosos chocolates que refletem a riqueza de nossa identidade.

Kop Koffee: Criada em 2019, a Kop Koffee é o lugar perfeito para compartilhar momentos de prazer, unindo o sabor do café à inconfundível qualidade dos chocolates Kopenhagen. Aqui, o sabor de inovação não é apenas um ingrediente, mas a energia que nos impulsiona a seguir inovando continuamente e proporcionando uma experiência única para os apaixonados por café e chocolate.

Descubra o incrível universo do chocolate, onde cada conexão transforma momentos comuns em experiências extraordinárias.

Sinta‑se convidado a fazer parte desse cenário envolvente e deixe sua marca, contribuindo para tornar cada momento inesquecível nesse universo apaixonante do chocolate.

Na LCA não são toleradas condutas de discriminação por razões como raça, cor, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, etnia, deficiência, religião, afiliação política, associação sindical, gravidez ou estado civil. A LCA está comprometida em promover um ambiente de trabalhado acolhedor, inclusivo e diverso.

Importante: por se tratar de um Banco de Talentos, não temos nenhuma previsão definitiva de quando a posição será aberta. Por isso, fique atento aos canais de comunicação.

A LCA é a maior consultoria econômica do Brasil. Atende clientes nacionais e internacionais nas áreas de finanças e em análises econômicas que envolvem regulação, políticas públicas, litígios, entre outros.

São aproximadamente 50 economistas, que atuam de forma integrada, agregando sinergias para o desenvolvimento de trabalhos de excelência.

O envolvimento em projetos é profundo, completo e imediato. O treinamento é na realidade. O ambiente é colaborativo, você sempre terá o suporte de todos.

Buscamos sempre construir um ótimo lugar para trabalhar e valorizamos o equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Respeitamos a individualidade e damos muita atenção a situações pessoais.

Atuamos pela diversidade e inclusão na LCA

A LCA valoriza a diversidade e incentiva a candidatura de pessoas que fazem parte dos grupos subrepresentados no mercado de trabalho: mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIA+, PCD e outros.

Desde setembro de 2021 temos um programa estruturado para promover a diversidade e um ambiente inclusivo. Temos atuado em governança, engajamento interno e atração e desenvolvimento de talentos com diversidade.

Promovemos conversas e palestras periódicas com pessoas convidadas de outras empresas e líderes de movimentos pro-diversidade.

Instituímos o Comitê de Inclusão e Diversidade que, aliado à alta direção, realizou o levantamento da situação das mulheres na LCA – que têm forte presença na liderança –; o censo de diversidade; e depois de um ano de programa, a pesquisa de inclusão e respeito pessoal e profissional.

Com base no que aprendemos, publicamos o Guia de boas práticas em respeito e inclusão, que você podeconsultar aqui .

Revimos nossas práticas de recrutamento e seleção com vistas a atrair e promover a diversidade. Estamos ativamente buscando pessoas não só de variadas características, como de diversas origens, formações e lugares de morada.

Nos primeiros doze meses do programa conseguimos contratar uma proporção três vezes maior de pessoas negras e LGBT em relação à média anterior – chegando a mais de 30% de representação de cada um desses grupos nas novas contratações.

Nossas pessoas pertencentes a grupos de diversidade recomendam a LCA para pessoas como elas trabalharem –veja aqui um resumo dos resultados da pesquisa. Estamos no começo, temos muito o que aprender e melhorar, e estes primeiros resultados só nos encorajam a seguir em frente.

description:

Design, implement, and integrate intelligent control solutions for agricultural machinery that increase operational efficiency, data transparency, and safety across Oxbo’s technology portfolio. Operating in a global environment, you will create real‑time control behavior (drive systems, hydraulics, autonomy, and safety), using model‑based design and embedded development to deliver standardized, high‑quality solutions for precision agriculture.

Responsibilities

  • Control & Autonomy: Develop and tune real‑time control algorithms for drive systems, electro‑hydraulics, safety logic, and advanced features such as path planning, collision avoidance, and autonomous harvesting.
  • Embedded Integration: Design and integrate controls with embedded ECUs, sensors, actuators, and machine hardware; implement redundancy and safety mechanisms.
  • Validation & Simulation: Build and maintain plant models; perform MIL/SIL (and bench/field) testing; analyze results and iterate to meet performance and safety targets.
  • Communication & Connectivity: Configure and validate CAN bus communication (J1939; ISOBUS/ISO11783 preferred); support telemetry/connectivity integrations.
  • Requirements & Quality: Capture and manage requirements (e.g., Codebeamer/Polarion), support DFMEA and compliance with global standards and architectural guidelines.
  • Process & Reuse: Apply modular design; create reusable software blocks and contribute to shared libraries; identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement in model‑based workflows.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with mechanical, electrical, automation, and software teams, as well as global suppliers/partners; communicate progress, risks, and decisions with stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Enablement: Maintain technical documentation, contribute to knowledge sharing, and (as applicable) support training for engineers, service teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Safety & Commissioning: Follow safety policies and best practices during development, testing, and machine commissioning.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s in Mechatronics, Electrical, Control/Automation, Software/Computer Engineering, Robotics, or related fields; Master’s is a plus.
  • Core Experience: Real‑time embedded development and/or industrial/off‑highway automation; model‑based design (MATLAB/Simulink) and Embedded C/C++; Git or similar VCS.
  • Protocols & Tools: CAN bus, J1939 (ISOBUS/ISO11783 preferred); Vector CANoe/CANalyzer or equivalent; requirements/toolchain familiarity (Codebeamer/Polarion; Office tools).

Nice to have

  • ROS or similar middleware; ladder logic for specific PLC/controls contexts.
  • Telemetry/telematics and connectivity systems.
  • Experience with global, standardized toolchains and shared architectures.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Clear, proactive communication with technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Strong teamwork in global, cross‑functional setups; sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Analytical problem‑solving; ability to negotiate trade‑offs with internal teams and suppliers.
  • Continuous improvement mindset; commitment to safety, quality, and process adherence.

title: Attending Veterinarian | Paulínia (SP)
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.

Position Summary

Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.

Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.
  • Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.
  • Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.
  • In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.
  • Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.
  • Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.
  • Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.
  • Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.
  • Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.
  • Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.
  • Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.
  • Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.
  • Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.
  • As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.
  • Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.
  • Previous technical experience with the facility's working species – poultry and rodents – is desirable.
  • Solid experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A master's or PhD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.
  • Planning and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments.
  • In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations.
  • Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.
  • Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.
  • The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on‑call schedules and veterinary occurrences.
  • The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.

About Zoetis

At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award‑winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well‑being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

We are implementing BEES systems with strategic partner companies across LATAM and are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to lead technical strategies, manage complex implementation projects, and act as the key connector between commercial, technical, and operational teams.

This role combines project management (PMO), technical ownership, and stakeholder management, ensuring successful end-to-end implementations and long-term partner success.

What you'll do:

  • Ensure the right product and service are delivered to partners on time and according to commercial agreements.

  • Monitor product performance and partner adoption, ensuring usage of best-in-class versions and tools.
  • Track the full customer journey, from order status to daily ticket volume and operational performance.
  • Manage post–go-live support, ensuring client sustainability through defined success KPIs and action plans.
  • Translate commercial needs into technical requirements, serving as a bridge between business and technology.
  • Build and maintain project documentation and governance.

What you'll need:

  • Proven experience in Project Management , Technical Account Management, TPM, or system implementation roles

  • Strong problem-solving skills and customer-centric mindset
  • Ability to manage stakeholders with flexibility, influence, and resilience
  • Comfort working in dynamic environments with high delivery expectations
  • Advanced communication skills in English (written and spoken)
  • Spanish at an advanced level (mandatory)
  • 100% availability to travel is required

Key challenges of the role:

  • Acting as a PMO , owning project schedules and holding stakeholders accountable to agreed timelines.
  • Working under delivery pressure in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Driving partner engagement and internal alignment after go-live through KPIs, action plans, and commercial demands.

More about you:

  • You're proactive, dynamic, and highly organized
  • Thinks end-to-end, understanding both technical workflows and commercial impact
  • Thrives in client‑facing roles and enjoys building long‑term partnerships
  • Sees themselves as a connector between teams, systems, and business goals

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.
Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.
This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people

Visão geral

A Unico é a maior rede de verificação de identidade do mundo e um pilar de confiança na sociedade digital. Com soluções baseadas em biometria facial, machine learning e camadas reforçadas de segurança, autenticamos com 100% de certeza quem está realizando uma transação e os riscos de identidade atrelados. Desta forma, nossas soluções combatem fraudes, protegem dados e promovem a confiança entre pessoas, empresas e governos, colaborando para a construção de um mundo mais seguro e menos burocrático. Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo.

Você será analista de dados com experiência em combate a fraudes e paixão por transformar dados brutos em inteligência acionável. Estamos buscando uma pessoa para análise de dados e técnicas de machine learning para identificar, prevenir e mitigar fraudes de forma proativa. Você será a peça-chave na construção de um ecossistema de dados robusto, que nos permitirá estar sempre um passo à frente dos fraudadores.

Responsabilidades

  • Análise Estratégica de Dados: Analisar grandes volumes de dados de transações e comportamento de usuários para identificar padrões, anomalias e tendências de fraude que ainda não foram detectadas
  • Melhoria Contínua: Utilizar dados de fraudes passadas para otimizar nossas estratégias de prevenção, garantindo que nossos sistemas estejam preparados para combater ameaças futuras

  • Modelos de Prevenção: Colaborar com a equipe de ciência de dados na criação e no treinamento de modelos de detecção de fraude, incluindo modelos de IA e visão computacional, para aumentar a precisão e a velocidade das nossas respostas

O que precisamos que você conheça

  • Experiência em Análise de Fraude: Experiência comprovada em análise de dados com foco em detecção e prevenção de fraudes
  • Análise de Dados em Tempo Real: Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de monitoramento e análise de dados em tempo real
  • ETL/ELT: Conhecimento sólido em processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados

  • Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta demanda e em esquema de plantão, quando necessário

4 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

About The Position

As a Solutions Architect, you will be a specialist in Azion products, capable of translating and interpreting market trends and business challenges into scalable solutions. Acting as a Trusted Advisor, you will ensure best practices in the use of our platform and support the success journey of our clients. You will validate, test, and debug complex issues related to clients’ use of Azion systems, and research new technologies to deliver tailored solutions. As a Solutions Architect, you must be committed to scalability, performance, high availability, and security best practices, ensuring success across various industries such as Finance, E-commerce, Media, and Education.

You are highly technical, client-focused, and able to communicate complex concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally. You understand enterprise environments, argue from a technical perspective, and inspire confidence. You stay up to date with Azion’s platform and market innovations and most importantly, you take initiative and chase results.

  • Actively participate in the planning and structuring of integration projects;
  • Integrate client systems with Azion’s platform, guiding and configuring environments when necessary;
  • Be the go-to expert for Azion products and solutions;

  • Identify and propose improvements in both processes and products driven by customer demand or internal insights;
  • Research and propose effective solutions for complex and non-standard use cases (corner cases).

What You’ll Bring

  • Understanding (and eagerness to learn) about networks and how the Internet works;
  • Protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS, BGP;
  • Security solutions: Firewalls, WAFs, Bot Management, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, Paywall;
  • Configuration and use of proxies and reverse proxies;
  • Content Delivery Networks (CDN), including caching and edge caching;
  • Experience with troubleshooting techniques: connectivity, routing, protocol errors, web applications, application mapping, etc.;
  • Knowledge of web performance optimization: latency, throughput, load distribution, load balancing;
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, BASH, JavaScript);
  • Proactive mindset for identifying and suggesting improvements;
  • Ability to handle multiple projects in an organized and collaborative way;
  • Ability to manage priorities, deadlines, and project delivery;
  • Willingness to stay updated with market technology trends;
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technology Management, or equivalent experience;

Bonus Points

  • Experience in consulting, technical training, or customer support;
  • Ability to analyze and define modern, distributed architectures;
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event/function-based integration;
  • Hands‑on experience with serverless and Function as a Service (FaaS) models, including Lambda Functions, Cloudlets, Workers, or similar technologies, with a focus on low latency, scalability, and orchestration;
  • Knowledge of streaming, distributed storage, high‑performance web servers, security, and cloud environments;
  • Advanced English and Spanish.

Estamos em busca de um Especialista de Produtos Jr para se juntar ao nosso time.

O que é um BMW Genius?

Um BMW Genius é um especialista em produtos da BMW, treinado para oferecer uma experiência de atendimento ao cliente focada em educação e informação, em vez de vendas. A função principal deles é guiar os clientes através dos recursos, tecnologias e funcionalidades dos veículos BMW, garantindo que o cliente tome uma decisão informada e se sinta confiante com o produto.

Principais responsabilidades de um BMW Genius:

  • Demonstração do produto : Eles são os responsáveis por apresentar detalhadamente os modelos, explicando as inovações, motores, sistemas de assistência ao motorista, e outros recursos. Eles podem, por exemplo, demonstrar como funciona o sistema de estacionamento automático ou o iDrive.

  • Aconselhamento e orientação : O Genius não tem metas de venda e, portanto, pode oferecer conselhos imparciais sobre qual modelo ou tecnologia se adapta melhor ao estilo de vida do cliente. Eles ajudam a comparar diferentes opções sem a pressão de fechar uma compra.

  • Suporte pós-venda : Após a compra, o Genius está disponível para auxiliar o cliente a se familiarizar com o novo carro. Eles podem ajudar a configurar o smartphone no veículo, explicar as funcionalidades do painel ou resolver dúvidas sobre o uso diário.

  • Treinamento : Eles recebem treinamento constante da BMW para se manterem atualizados sobre todos os novos modelos e tecnologias. Isso permite que eles sejam uma fonte confiável de informação, seja sobre um carro recém-lançado ou uma nova atualização de software.

Em resumo, o BMW Genius é um consultor, um educador e um embaixador da marca, focado em criar um relacionamento de confiança com o cliente, oferecendo um serviço de alto nível e conhecimento técnico aprofundado. Eles complementam o trabalho do vendedor, garantindo que a jornada de compra seja a mais informativa e agradável possível.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.

Overview:

We are seeking a Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear Specialist to join the Technical Services Division/ High Voltage Equipment Unit (HVEU). The Technical Services Division is responsible for providing and managing highly technical and specialized engineering services to support the safe and reliable operation of Saudi Aramco’s electrical transmission and distribution networks. Your primary role is to provide specialized technical support in regards to designs, standards, commissioning, maintenance, operation, investigation in order to ensure safe and reliable Power Supply.

Key Responsibilities:

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Serves as Subject Matter Expert in equipment failures and repair techniques during root cause investigations.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis on all critical equipment failures.
  • Perform continuous review of the HV equipment maintenance programs to identify improvements to ensure the HV asset's safe and reliable operation.
  • Provide technical consultation to the maintenance agency as required in identifying and reviewing critical spare parts lists of existing equipment.
  • Provide technical consultation to assess the condition of aging switchgears and breakers including the use of new innovative technologies.
  • Provide technical expertise on troubleshooting failures, repairs, and evaluating if the equipment is designed to meet its intended or existing service conditions.
  • Provide technical engineering input on repair details and offers onsite technical support, especially for critical equipment for the process.
  • Provide engineering input for switchgear work packages to ensure Saudi Aramco standards and material specifications are followed.
  • Review and update company standards and be familiar with international standards.

As a successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years’ experience of operations and maintenance experience directly working with MV switchgear/control gear.
  • You will have In-depth knowledge, experience, and recognition as a switchgear specialist including membership of international engineering bodies and contribution at international conferences.
  • Background in the oil and gas industry or equipment manufacturers is a plus.
  • Professional Engineer certification such as chartership or PE is a plus.
  • You will have a working Knowledge of ANSI and IEC designed switchgear, breaker design (including mechanisms and interruption technology - vacuum, air, compressed air, SF-6), motor control gears, motor contactors, and pad-mounted SF-6 equipment.
  • You will have the ability to multi-task and manage changing priorities and seek opportunities to improve results and processes proactively, contributing to the goals, safety, and profitability of the company.
  • You will be able to integrate and quickly applying newly acquired technical information
  • You will have strong speaking, writing, and customer service skills.
  • You will also be able to complete daily work activities with limited supervision and able to work cooperatively in a team environment.

Work Location and Work Schedule:

Work location: Within Saudi Arabia: On-Site

Work schedule: Full Time - To be specified in Job offer

Working environment:

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Performance Marketing Manager (DTC E-Commerce)

About Purolabs

Purolabs is a fast-growing DTC supplements brand based in the UK with over 350,000 happy customers.

We create clean, science-backed supplements that actually work. No fillers, no nasties, just real results.

Featured in Vogue, Women's Health, and Evening Standard, our UK-made products are trusted by health-conscious people who refuse to compromise on quality.

We're a small, family-run team that values ownership, transparency, and getting things done without the bureaucracy.

The Role

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid acquisition channels.

You'll be the person in the ad accounts every day, not reviewing dashboards from a distance. This role is equal parts strategist and executor. You'll plan the roadmap, build the campaigns, analyse the data, and optimise for profitable growth.

Your primary focus will be Meta Ads, with responsibility for expanding into TikTok, Google, and YouTube as we grow. You'll work directly with our founders and collaborate with our creative team to develop winning ad concepts and high-converting funnels.

This isn't about vanity metrics. We care about contribution margin, not just ROAS. You'll need to think commercially and understand how paid media fits into the bigger picture of customer acquisition and lifetime value.

What You'll Own

  • Full management of Meta Ads, from campaign builds to daily optimisation and scaling
  • Testing new platforms including TikTok, Google, and YouTube
  • Creative strategy and briefing, working with designers and video editors to produce scroll-stopping ads

  • Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into action

Nice to Have

What We Offer

  • Direct access to founders with real input on strategy
  • Opportunity to shape the marketing function of a growing brand
  • Products that genuinely help people feel better

Important

  • This is a contractor position (not employment)
  • Applications welcome globally
  • Minimum 4-hour daily overlap with UK hours required

Platform Science is seeking a skilled and proactive Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to contribute to the quality of our growing software products. You will independently design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test scripts. Integrating quality into our CI/CD pipeline and collaborating closely with development teams, you will play a key role in ensuring the delivery of reliable and performant software solutions.

  • Stay updated on relevant testing methodologies, tools, and technologies, and share knowledge within the team.
  • Actively participate in agile ceremonies, providing valuable input on quality and testability.
  • May contribute to performance and security testing efforts under guidance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in software development and/or test automation.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, PyTest).
  • Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Github Actions , CircleCI).
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the SDLC.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with performance testing basics (e.g., using tools like K6, JMeter).
  • Exposure to security testing concepts.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience working in an agile development environment.
  • Experience with AI Tools in Software Development (Gemini, Windsurf, Claude, etc.)

  • Event-driven architecture: Kinesis Streams, Lambdas
  • Version control & Collaboration: GitHub, Slack, Confluence, Jira

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps roles
  • Proven experience managing and improving production systems in a cloud-native environment (preferably AWS)
  • Strong experience with observability tools and practices
  • Experience defining and driving adoption of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs
  • Experience in operating event-driven systems and distributed architectures
  • Solid understanding of Terraform and infrastructure as code best practices
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across the stack
  • Comfortable writing and reviewing production-grade code (preferably in Java)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English
  • A pragmatic and collaborative mindset, with a passion for system reliability and operational excellence
  • Bachelor\'s degree in computer science or similar fields preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with performance tuning in large-scale systems
  • Exposure to error budget policies and DORA metrics

description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We\'ve built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you\'ll do

We\'re looking for an AWS Cost Optimization Specialist . At Clara, our infrastructure is the backbone of our financial services, and managing it efficiently is key to our scalability and unit economics. You will design and execute Clara\'s AWS cost optimization strategy, moving beyond simple monitoring to proactive financial engineering.

Your mission is to bridge the gap between Engineering and Finance, ensuring that every dollar spent on the cloud translates into direct value for our customers. You will drive visibility into cost per transaction and cost per product while building the automated governance required for a high-growth fintech.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Analysis: Design and execute the global AWS cost optimization strategy, continuously identifying savings across EC2 , ECS , and Aurora clusters.
  • Governance & Tagging: Implement standardized tagging strategies for precise cost allocation by domain, squad, country, and product.
  • Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize AWS Kafka clusters, OpenSearch storage strategies, and networking/data transfer costs to ensure lean operations.
  • FinOps Automation: Define and implement automated shutdown policies for non-production environments and configure advanced anomaly detection and budget alerts.
  • Data & Dashboards: Build executive and operational dashboards using AWS Cost Explorer, Athena , or QuickSight to provide real-time visibility into cloud spend.
  • Architectural Partnership: Partner with engineering teams to design cost-efficient architectures and establish long-term cloud financial governance standards.

Who you are

“We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.”

Must haves:

  • 4+ years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments, with a proven track record in cloud cost optimization initiatives.
  • Strong technical knowledge of EC2 , EBS, RDS, S3, EKS , Lambda, and CloudFront.
  • Mastery of AWS Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and multi-account environment management via AWS Organizations.
  • Experience implementing FinOps best practices and strong understanding of cost modeling.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, specifically Terraform .
  • Ability to analyze cost data using SQL , Athena , or Python .
  • Working proficiency in English and Spanish.
  • Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows and detect spending patterns.

Nice to haves:

  • AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps, or Advanced Networking).
  • Experience in regulated environments (PCI, SOC2).
  • Experience with cloud cost management and optimization platforms (CloudHealth, CloudCheckr, or native AWS cost tools).
  • Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.
  • A good sense of humor.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

Certified as one of the world\'s fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

#Pride. We build products and experiences we\'re proud of.

#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you\u2019re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara employees in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don\'t enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you\'re expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

You will collaborate with product owners and development teams to ensure our application frameworks are robust, future-proof, and aligned with business goals. Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, messaging systems like Kafka or MQTT, monitoring tools like Grafana, and security standards (OAuth2, OpenID).

Overview

Join to apply for the Engineering Lead role at TELUS Digital Brazil .

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times per week or 8 days per month) or Porto Alegre (3 times per week or 12 days per month). Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As an Engineering Lead at TELUS Digital, you’ll be a manager of a highly skilled engineering team building amazing digital products for our clients, and you’ll help them achieve their personal and professional goals. You’ll also drive the team and our clients to use cutting-edge techniques and processes for software delivery, and use your technical prowess to shape the solutions we create. Success looks like an energized, happy team building high-quality software for eager, engaged client stakeholders.

We understand our responsibility to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive place within the tech industry, while pushing to make our industry more representative. Because of this responsibility, we need candidates who value diversity and inclusion through their work, team collaboration, or mentorship.

  • Have professional engineering experience — at least 5 years building digital products, and at least 2 years leading a team;
  • Have professional engineering experience with Mobile app development technologies (Android, IOS or React Native) and/or Web development technologies (React, Next, Angular, Vue; Node, .NET, Java);
  • Have managed a team of software engineers building digital products, and been responsible for growing the people on the team through goal-setting, coaching and feedback;
  • Have familiarity with CI/CD, Agile techniques for managing work, pairing, mobbing, and shift-left testing;
  • Have owned the delivery of a complete digital product, with code that is durable, secure, scalable and thoroughly tested;
  • Can simplify and communicate about complex problems around technology, business processes, user experience and development tasks;
  • Fluent English and Portuguese skills – including written, verbal, and presentation;
  • This role is open to our São Paulo or Porto Alegre office.

Bonus Points

  • Professional experience as a Project or Product Manager and Scrum Master from a major technology consultancy or agency
  • You’ve guided a client to further their use of modern engineering practices or agile software delivery processes
  • Certifications such as CSM, CSPO, PMP, SA, SPC, etc.

  • Think of the product you are building as part of an ecosystem of development, testing and deployment tools and processes
  • Pride yourself on your work and take responsibilities and commitments seriously
  • Value daily opportunities to immerse yourself deeply in your work
  • Celebrate differences and thrive in an environment where everyone’s unique contributions are encouraged
  • Value a feedback culture that fosters personal and professional growth

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some Of Our Benefits

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

Equality

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

description:
Network Engineer – Citrix ADC to F5 Migration Specialist

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

  • Lead the end-to-end migration from Citrix ADC to F5 BIG-IP, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
  • Collaborate with the Engineering team to develop migration strategies and incorporate their recommendations into the project.
  • Assess existing Citrix ADC configurations, including load balancing, SSL offloading, authentication, and security policies.
  • Design and implement F5 BIG-IP architectures that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Configure and test F5 BIG-IP features such as LTM, SSL/TLS profiles, persistence, iRules, and high availability.
  • Perform traffic cutover to F5 BIG-IP in a phased manner to minimize service disruptions.
  • Conduct functional and performance testing to validate migration success and address any issues.
  • Optimize F5 BIG-IP configurations for performance, security, and reliability.
  • Document new F5 BIG-IP configurations and provide training to the Operations and Support teams.
  • Offer post-migration support and address any issues identified during the transition phase.
  • Monitor and log network traffic to ensure proactive issue identification and resolution.

Must Have

  • Strong experience with Citrix ADC (NetScaler) and F5 BIG-IP (LTM).
  • Deep knowledge of load balancing, SSL/TLS offloading, session persistence, and traffic management.
  • Experience in high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations.
  • Familiarity with security features such as WAF, access control policies, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting F5 iRules.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Ability to work closely with Engineering and Operations teams to align project strategies and incorporate feedback.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Awareness of security best practices in automation and the ability to implement secure coding principles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • F5 Certified Administrator (F5-CA) or F5 Certified Technical Specialist (F5-CTS) preferred.
  • Citrix certifications such as CCP-N (Citrix Certified Professional – Networking) are a plus.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in network engineering, with significant experience in Citrix ADC and F5 BIG-IP migration or administration.
  • Experience in enterprise-level network environments and large-scale migrations.
